_readme: Copy to ~/.omp/agent/omo-personas.json. By default each agent binds to an OMP model role (sisyphus=default, prometheus=plan, atlas=task, momus/oracle=advisor, librarian/explore=smol, multimodal-looker=vision, hephaestus/metis/sisyphus-junior=default) and tracks whatever you set in /model. Pins below OVERRIDE the role for that agent. Format: 'provider/model' or 'provider/model:thinking'. Remove keys you don't use.
